Flight altitudes from just above treetops to 3,000 feet
Views of downtown Denver, Rocky Mountains, wildlife including deer, fox, coyote, bald eagle

blurb: Guests take a hot air balloon flight lasting 45 to 60+ minutes over Colorado scenery including Denver and the Rocky Mountains. Flights operate year round, weather permitting, and include a post flight celebration with mimosas, pastries, fresh fruit, and yogurt. Each guest receives a certificate of flight as a keepsake.
extraNote: Reservations secured with major credit card; card charged after flight · Cancellations within 48 hours or no-shows charged full amount · 48 hour cancellation notice required · No charge if flight cancelled by operator due to weather or safety · Weather is primary factor; flights at sunrise for stable air · Gratuity customary, 10-15% suggested, may be added to credit card after flight · Chatfield State Park launch site parking lot; directions provided on site · Year round, weather permitting
